note: The two sets are nearly identical in content, sharing the same core claims (material properties from Table 4-1, 0.170 Hz first mode, 150 m hub height, 10 m monopile diameter, 30 m clearance with 120-m blades) and the same questionable items (a 0.18 Hz tower frequency that contradicts the stated 0.170 Hz, an invented 'steady-state' condition, and duplicated claims). Set A keeps the WISDEM/OpenFAST design condition on the material claim and uses a clean quote for the figure-derived frequency, while Set B drops that condition and appends a bracketed annotation ('[vertical line at ~0.17]') that is not document text. These differences are trivial, so the sets are effectively equivalent in correctness and coverage.
